messages:
maya: Drafted release notes PR with a hero block for Adaptive routing and updated SDK snippets. Heads up: changelog index anchors are flaky on staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234
kevin: looking now — hero block looks clean. where exactly are anchors failing?
maya: Top-level changelog index links jump to top of page instead of sections. Repro in Chrome + Safari. Suspect markdown processor upgrade (v2 -> v3) changed id generation.
eli: saw that earlier. Quick guess: heading ids get different slugging / unicode normalization now.
sasha: if it's slug mismatch we can normalize during build. propose NFKD + strip non-word -> '-'.
kevin: @sasha can you paste a snippet? :eyes:
sasha: ```bash
# tools/slugify.sh (invoked by docs-build)
python - <<'PY'
import unicodedata,sys,re
def slug(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
    s = s.encode('ascii','ignore').decode()
    s = re.sub(r"[^\w]+", '-', s).strip('-').lower()
    print(s)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    slug(sys.stdin.read().strip())
PY
```
tom: note: adding a new slugifier could change existing permalinks. we should add redirects for old anchors so published links don't 404.
maya: agree. i'll add entries in _redirects and also put a small known-issue note in the release draft: "Changelog anchors may be broken on staging; use page search or direct permalink until fix rolls out."
kevin: FYI the python SDK snippet still used the old kwargs; i pushed a tiny fix to the PR branch (updated example to match client v0.9).
docs-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.com (checks: lint OK, linkcheck FAIL: 3 broken anchors)
eli: linkcheck output shows:
```
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #changelog-adaptive-routing
ERROR: /guides/embeddings.html: missing anchor #embedding-streaming
ERROR: /sdk/python/examples.html: missing anchor #sdk-examples
```
sasha: i'll open a tiny redirects+slugify PR (will add canonical slug logic + redirect table) and tag you all.
maya: can someone write a one-line known-issue bullet for the release notes? draft: "Known issue: Some changelog anchors may not work on staging due to heading id changes; fix rolling out. Workaround: use page search or direct permalink"
tom: lgtm. add ETA if possible (e.g., fix in next deploy, ~1-2 hours).
kevin: added ETA + redirect mention, pushed commit to PR branch.
docs-bot: PR #1234 merged by kevin into main. Release note draft now at /releases/v1.7.0-draft
maya: thanks all. i'll finalize the release note (include SDK snippet diffs under "Developer notes") and ping legal for banner copy.
sasha: redirects/slugify PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1235 — review appreciated.
eli: quick QA after merge: adaptive-routing anchor fixed on staging; embedding anchor still missing (redirect in PR1235 pending).
maya: :thumbsup: closing thread — will re-open if linkcheck surfaces more failures.
